start.title: La voz de lo alto
start.text:
Dios te habla.
«Hazte un arca. Se acerca un diluvio.»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Un mundo que observa
mockery.text:
El mundo a tu alrededor es corrupto y violento.
Te observan construir. ¿Cómo respondes?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Ciprés y brea
building.text:
Reúnes los materiales que Dios mandó.
¿Cómo construyes el arca?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Está terminada
ark_done.text:
El arca está completa, exactamente como Dios mandó.
¿Qué aspecto tiene?

choices.text: [TODO:es] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:es] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:es] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Vienen las criaturas
animals.text:
Los animales llegan al arca.
¿A quiénes subes a bordo?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: La puerta cerrada
boarding.text:
Es hora de entrar en el arca.
¿Quién entra y quién cierra la puerta?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Cuarenta días de lluvia
storm.text:
Las ventanas de los cielos se abren.
¿Qué sucede?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:es] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Sobre las aguas
inside.text:
El arca flota sobre las profundidades.
¿Cuánto tiempo prevalecen las aguas sobre la tierra?

choices.text: [TODO:es] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:es] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:es] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: La paloma regresa
dove.text:
Las aguas comienzan a retroceder.
¿Cómo sabes que la tierra seca está cerca?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: Tierra bajo tus pies
dry_land.text:
El Señor te dice que salgas del arca.
¿Qué haces primero en tierra seca?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: El arcoíris
covenant.text:
Un arcoíris se extiende por el cielo.
«Nunca más volveré a inundar la tierra. Este es mi pacto contigo.»
